description: Residual RL post-training (lab ResFiT recipe) of a frozen base candidate (policy or program) on the station's training starts: a small actor adds a bounded, incremental correction - palm xy / xyz offset (through the identified arm model's IK, base orientation kept) or arm-joint offset - on top of the base's action; the current offset is part of its state. TD3; each step pays offset_reg (default 0.5) * mean((offset/scale)^2), and the actor waits until the critic has seen one round of finished episodes. Reward = terms you choose, each {id, weight, params}: a lab term (LAB REWARD TERMS), or id=expression with params.expr = a reward from the work library (or your own) transcribed over station features, params.source = its work-library id; success_sparse weight = success bonus (default 10). Creates up to four candidates <name>_at<episodes>. Lab evidence: works for precision placement after a base that already grasps; cannot repair missed grasps. Station evidence (cup_lift 11-12): a gripper-centred shaping term (palm to object centre, Text2Reward LiftCube) drove the palm into the cup with a dexterous hand; prefer success / lift / hold terms unless the reference point fits this hand's grasp.

costs.all: its episodes as training episodes; ~1-2 s per station step for 16 envs
